to do with the new log probability function I added.
It should be making it much faster :-)

I'm also thinking we want to have an option to just
dump out this report without the finite diffs. Assuming
we've done everyting right on our side, the users shouldn't
need it in most cases to diagnose errors in their own
models.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] stan test gradient mode
parts:
I introduced the bug and I just pushed a fix to revert
it to where it was before. I'm really glad you (Jiqiang)
caught the bug.

The problem is that I wrote a new log_prob method in
the generated model code that works on double types.
But I forgot to change the propto template param
from true to false so that the values weren't all zero.

And I just realized that if I do fix the propto template param
to be false, then the log probability value won't be the
same as that returned by the model --- it would include
the constant terms. And I think that's too confusing.

So I just took it out pending more thought on the right
thing to to do.
